create_job_in_queue: create a job in the MongoDB queue with type, dataset, revision, difficulty, and priority
start_next_waiting_job: start the next waiting job from the priority-ordered queue with difficulty filters
finish_and_delete_job: finish a started job, delete it from the queue, and record it in past jobs
get_zombie_jobs: get zombie jobs that have not sent a heartbeat within the specified timeout
get_pending_jobs_dataframe: get a pandas DataFrame of pending jobs for a dataset with priority and status categorization
